create_MyEnv: create a Gym environment with Discrete(2) actions that moves state x by 0.3 per step
create_UniformAgent: create an Agent that samples actions from a softmax categorical distribution over n_actions
create_EpisodeBatcher: create a multi-process EpisodeBatcher with 4 threads to collect full episodes in parallel
execute_batcher: execute the EpisodeBatcher to acquire 32 episodes with agent_info and env_info DictTensors
get_trajectories: get collected trajectories from the EpisodeBatcher using the blocking get method
